difference: The source already rejects one direct jump and warns that a prescribed halving sequence may accumulate. This argument covers every adaptive step choice, frequency cutoff, precision, mixed-rule path and branch, with an explicit finite ceiling. It does not revive a killed positive cofinal inference.
method: All terms of the threshold-exclusion cost are nonnegative and J_B>4; the older dilation cost dominates 5(1-alpha^-2)>=4 log(alpha) for 1<alpha<2. Telescope the certified-margin losses along every adaptive branch.
next_test: Retain the changed valid spatial-Gamma whole old comparison and prove its signed Schur inequality for every odd shell-domain vector, not only the already certified fixed degree19 shell line. Such a full new window would be fresh information beyond this budget theorem.
object: Universal telescoping certificate-budget ceiling for arbitrary adaptive iteration and mixing of the two specified complete signed-Weil scalar window-transport rules.
obligations: Global Weil positivity and a cofinal family remain open.
The spatial whole-shell Schur obligation is stated as the current existing gap, not a newly proved equivalence.
Existing full-window input and transport source premises are inherited, not independently reconstructed from every older artifact.
scope: For certificates generated exclusively by the two named rules from (L0,m0), m_N+4 log(L_N/L0)<=m0. With L0=9/4 and m0=3e-38, every certified support diameter has supremum below 9/4+2e-38. This is not an upper bound on actual Weil positivity, not a counterexample to RH, and not a ban on independently proved fresh margins or different source-specific transport rules.
stop_condition: Do not promote scalar-rule failure to actual Weil negativity; do not reset a certificate margin at a new support without independent proof; do not replace the full shell input by finitely many favorable vectors.
